categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in industrial-grade metal additive manufacturing (3D printing), providing comprehensive solutions including R&D and production of metal 3D printing equipment, customized metal 3D printed products, metal 3D printing raw materials, structural optimization design, and related technical services. It also acts as an agent for sales of German EOS metal additive manufacturing equipment. The business covers equipment manufacturing, product customization, raw material production, software development, and technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops and manufactures metal 3D printing equipment based on Selective Laser Melting (SLM), Laser Solid Forming (LSF), and Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM) technologies. It has proprietary technologies for large-size multi-laser systems, powder recycling, and automated powder handling. The company also develops specialized metal powders and advanced printing processes for various alloys including titanium, high-temperature alloys, aluminum, and copper. It emphasizes integrated software solutions for equipment control and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily in aerospace, industrial machinery, energy and power, scientific research institutes, medical research, automotive manufacturing, and electronics industries. The aerospace sector contributes over 56% of revenue, with strong collaborations with major Chinese aerospace and defense entities and international partners like Airbus. The company also serves industrial, medical, and research markets domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and multiple subsidiaries in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, and branches in Jiangsu, Shenzhen, Shanghai, Hong Kong, and Europe (Germany). It serves domestic markets extensively and has growing overseas sales, including Europe, South Korea, Japan, Poland, and Nigeria through partnerships and subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the metal additive manufacturing supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and sells metal 3D printing equipment and raw materials, produces customized 3D printed metal parts, and provides related software and technical services, thus covering a full solution provider role in the metal additive manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous investment in R&D to maintain technological leadership in metal additive manufacturing, focusing on large-size multi-laser equipment, new alloy powder development, process innovation, and automation. The company undertakes national key projects and emphasizes smart manufacturing, digitalization, and scale-up of production capacity. It aims to expand applications across industries and enhance international market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of self-developed metal 3D printing equipment, customized 3D printed metal products, and metal 3D printing raw materials. Additional income comes from technical services, software sales, and agency sales of imported equipment. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance, with a direct sales model dominating.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in metal additive manufacturing with a comprehensive product and service portfolio. It competes with international firms like German EOS and other global additive manufacturing equipment providers. It holds a strong market position in China, especially in aerospace, and is recognized for its advanced technology and scale. The company is expanding its international footprint and maintains competitive advantages through innovation and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.23 billion, a 34.24% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 141.6 million, up 78.11%. Total assets grew to about RMB 6.57 billion, and net assets attributable to shareholders increased by 211.87% to RMB 4.77 billion. The company has a workforce of 1,720 employees, with about 30% in R&D, and continues to invest heavily in innovation, reflecting a strong growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive metal additive manufacturing ecosystem, integrating equipment, materials, software, and services to deliver one-stop solutions. Its proprietary multi-laser large-format equipment, advanced powder materials, and process innovations enable production of complex, lightweight, and integrated metal parts with high precision and efficiency. The company’s ability to provide customized products, rapid repair and remanufacturing services, and scalable production distinguishes it in the market, particularly in aerospace and high-end industrial applications.
